about: FFM engine speed benchmark, 2026-10-25 (tests/evidence/engines). Mac Studio M3 Ultra, 28 logical CPUs. Per-orbit rows: plan.mjs cases, 3 days from 2026-08-02T00:00 UTC, hourly samples; vsFfm and vsOwn in meters (largest 3D difference over the 3 days). Catalog: the Space-Track GP snapshot of 2026-10-04 (/opt/data/sdn-archive/spacetrack/gp/2026/2026-10-04.json.gz, not redistributed), each object from its element-set epoch through 2026-10-05T00:00Z + 3 days, FFM-1 forces on constant space weather (catalog-environment.mjs).
